request: Pull NASA JPL CNEOS Sentry impact-risk catalog (~2160 asteroids on the risk list, with cumulative Palermo scale and impact probability). Enrich each row with palermo_band and days_since_last_obs. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 20 - NASA CNEOS Sentry Impact Risks' on Tableau Server for planetary-defense + space-domain-awareness analysts.

sources.name: NASA CNEOS Sentry Impact Risks
sources.description: NASA JPL Center for Near-Earth Object Studies (CNEOS) Sentry risk table via `ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sentry.api`. Flat envelope: {signature, count, fields, data:[{des, id, fullname, ip (impact probability, cumulative), n_imp (# potential impacts), ps_max (Palermo scale, max single-event), ps_cum (Palermo scale, cumulative), ts_max (Torino scale, max single-event), last_obs (yyyy-mm-dd), last_obs_jd, h (absolute magnitude), v_inf (velocity infinity km/s), range (yyyy-yyyy impact-search interval), diameter (km)}, ...]}. Public, no auth, no rate limit — refreshed by CNEOS operations pipeline as new observations arrive. Note: ip and Palermo/Torino scale strings; cast to decimal for banding.

args.name: Sentry Trend
args.features_description: Row-level CNEOS Sentry risk entry with calendar features derived from `last_obs` (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week).
args.stats_description: Long-form CNEOS Sentry impact-risk statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over diameter_class and palermo_band). Includes 365-day rolling counts and z-score anomalies. Use to spot observation cadence gaps and Palermo-band shifts.

outputs.name: CNEOS Sentry Detail
outputs.description: Row-level NASA JPL CNEOS Sentry impact-risk table (~2160 asteroids). Fields: des, id, fullname, ip (cumulative impact probability), n_imp (# potential impact events), ps_max/ps_cum (Palermo scale max & cumulative — >0 = higher than background, negative = lower), ts_max (Torino scale 0-10), last_obs (yyyy-mm-dd), last_obs_jd, h (absolute magnitude), v_inf (km/s), range (yyyy-yyyy interval), diameter (km), diameter_class (small<30m / medium<140m / large<1km / very_large>=1km), palermo_band (negligible/very_low/low/elevated/high thresholded on ps_cum), days_since_last_obs. Plus calendar features. Source: ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/sentry.api. Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: CNEOS Sentry Stats
outputs.description: Long-form Sentry impact-risk statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over diameter_class and palermo_band). Includes 365-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to spot risk-catalog drift over time.
